# D fiscal 2002 annual report (10-K), page 87

Power purchase contracts dominion has entered into contracts for long-term purchases of capacity and energy from other utilities, qualifying facilities and independent power producers. |   | Commitment |   |
|---|---|---|
| (millions) | Capacity | Other |
| 2003 | $643 | $44 |
| 2004 | 635 | 29 |
| 2005 | 629 | 22 |
| 2006 | 614 | 18 |
| 2007 | 589 | 11 |
| Later years | 5,259 | 113 |
| Total | 8,369 | 237 |
